tests_to_contract.api-exports: Root ESM import exposes the documented runtime names and default produce.
tests_to_contract.package-contract: Package metadata has exact name/version/type/exports and zero runtime dependencies.
tests_to_contract.produce-noop: No recipe mutation returns the original JSON state identity.
tests_to_contract.produce-does-not-mutate-base: Draft mutation changes only the produced copy.
tests_to_contract.delete-property: Deleting a draft property removes it from the result.
tests_to_contract.array-splice: Draft array splice removes and inserts in order.
tests_to_contract.array-shift-unshift: Shift and unshift preserve array order.
tests_to_contract.nothing-sentinel: Returning nothing produces undefined in the direct runtime contract.
tests_to_contract.auto-freeze-default: Produced draftable containers are deeply frozen by default.
tests_to_contract.freeze-deep: freeze(value,true) recursively freezes containers and returns value.
tests_to_contract.patches-replace: A scalar replacement emits replace and inverse replace.
tests_to_contract.patches-add-remove: Adding and removing object keys emits add/remove patches.
tests_to_contract.patches-array: Array insertion/removal patches preserve paths and order.
tests_to_contract.apply-patches: Applying forward patches reproduces the produced state.
tests_to_contract.inverse-patches: Applying inverse patches restores the original state.
tests_to_contract.draft-used-after-finish: A finalized draft cannot be mutated successfully.
tests_to_contract.observe-current-original: current and original expose current/original snapshots.
tests_to_contract.observe-is-draft: isDraft is true only for a live draft.
tests_to_contract.is-draftable: Arrays/plain objects are draftable; primitives/null are not.
tests_to_contract.json-coercion: JSON values remain deterministic across the boundary.
tests_to_contract.repeated-result: Repeated equivalent operations return identical JSON results.
